question: Identify the synonym of 'Blatant'
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Obvious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Blatant"** refers to something that is done openly and unashamedly; it is very obvious and often considered offensive. (स्पष्ट और अशिष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician’s blatant disregard for the rules shocked everyone.
 
 
• The correct synonym of "Blatant" is **"Obvious"**, which means something that is easily perceived or understood; clear and apparent. (स्पष्ट)
